data.one_liner: A thin wrapper around Provider that automatically calls dispose.
data.what_it_does: DisposableProvider extends the standard Provider package functionality by automatically calling dispose on provided objects when they are removed from the tree. It helps manage resources without requiring manual cleanup boilerplate.
use_when: You are already using the provider package and need automatic disposal of provided objects.
You want a lightweight wrapper to handle resource cleanup for state objects.
avoid_when: You are using modern state management alternatives like Riverpod or Bloc that handle disposal natively.
You do not use the provider package in your application.
strengths: Automates the disposal of provided objects
Acts as a thin, seamless wrapper around the standard Provider
weaknesses: Tied directly to the lifecycle and ecosystem of the provider package
Limited documentation beyond the basic example

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: The standard state management library maintained by the Flutter community if you prefer standard provider behavior without extra wrappers.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: A modern and robust alternative to provider that natively handles auto-disposal and provider lifecycles.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: A predictable state management library that automatically disposes blocs and cubits.
